data.body: Review iteration milestone: Gerrit 2801 PS1 received LLM-Review -1 for over-exempting all text inside ## Acceptance Criteria, not exercising the post-AC recharge branch, and duplicating heading/fence parsing. PS2 fixes this by adding canonical parsed AC item character accounting in _plan_clarity, exempting only standard checklist item text (including fenced/indented continuation), charging incidental AC-section prose and post-AC prose, and adding regression tests for those branches. Full make verify passed again after the amend.
